{{Quote|It's ''not right'', master. The people of this world will suffer for no other reason than their planet is in the ''wrong place'' at the ''wrong time''.|Anakin Skywalker, to Obi-Wan Kenobi, before their retreat from Nexus Ortai|<ref name="Shipyards of Doom" />}}
A '''battle''' was fought in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. When Confederate forces tried to invade the strategically situated [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Nexus Ortai/Legends|Nexus Ortai]], they were confronted by a Republic [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] commanded by [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Wullf Yularen/Legends|Wullf Yularen]], [[High Jedi General/Legends|High Jedi General]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], and [[Jedi Commander/Legends|Jedi Commander]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]]. The Republic forces were successful in repelling the initial Separatist attack but took heavy damage while doing so. After [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] arrived with Separatist reinforcements, the Republic was forced to retreat from the [[Star system/Legends|system]].

==The battle==
{{Quote|It was a tough fight, but this system is safe from tyranny.''"<br />"General Skywalker!'' We have another problem&mdash;Separatist reinforcements have just arrived!|Anakin Skywalker and Admiral Wullf Yularen|<ref name="Shipyards of Doom" />}}
In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="FF-23" /> early in the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] initiated an invasion against the peaceful [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Nexus Ortai/Legends|Nexus Ortai]], hoping to conquer the planet because of its strategic position at the crossroads of [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|lanes]]. In order to defend the planet, a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]]&mdash;commanded by [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Wullf Yularen/Legends|Wullf Yularen]], [[High Jedi General/Legends|High Jedi General]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], and [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]&mdash;engaged Confederate [[Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|''Munificent''-class star frigates]] and [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|Vulture droid starfighters]] above Nexus Ortai. Kenobi and Skywalker, flying [[Delta-7B Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|Delta-7B ''Aethersprite''-class light interceptors]], led [[V-19 Torrent starfighter/Legends|V-19 Torrent starfighters]] of [[Ghost Squadron]] against the Confederate Vulture [[Droid/Legends|droids]]. Skywalker's [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], was willing to fight alongside her master, but the latter forbid her to do so, ordering Tano to stay aboard one of the Republic's [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyers]] and learn from Yularen.<ref name="Shipyards of Doom" />

After both sides had sustained heavy damage, Skywalker ordered Ghost Squadron to attack the Separatist [[Command ship/Legends|command ship]], while he and Kenobi took care of the [[Droid starfighter/Legends|droid starfighters]]. Despite Kenobi's protests, Skywalker took many droids by himself and demonstrated his exceptional [[Pilot/Legends|piloting]] skills by destroying them. Soon, Ghost Squadron succeeded in destroying the command ship, and the Republic considered the Separatists to be finished. At that point, however, more Separatist [[Starship/Legends|starships]] arrived, commanded by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]]. Realizing that their forces could not hold off against the Confederate reinforcements, Kenobi ordered Yularen to prepare the fleet for withdrawal, much to Skywalker's dismay. After picking up the two Jedi and remaining pilots of Ghost Squadron, the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]] jumped to hyperspace and retreated to Republic territory.<ref name="Shipyards of Doom" />

==Aftermath==
[[File:Windu_briefing.jpg|thumb|left|160px|Mace Windu briefs other Jedi on the Separatist advantage in the number of starships.]]
{{Quote|Our problem is simple&mdash;the Separatist navy has four times the number of ships we do. We must slow down their ship production or this war will end quickly, and not in our favor.|[[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]]|<ref name="Shipyards of Doom" />}}
The loss of Nexus Ortai marked nearly two dozen worlds that the Republic had to pull back from in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. The main reason for this was revealed to be the [[Confederate Navy/Legends|Confederate Navy's]] advantage in size, giving them four times as many ships as the Republic. To this end, [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] proposed to strike at one of the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan's]] [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyards]] producing [[Warship/Legends|warships]] for the Confederacy. Skywalker then formulated a plan to [[Battle of Gwori|infiltrate]] the Separatist-controlled [[Gwori system/Legends|Gwori system]] and destroy [[Gwori shipyards|the shipyards]] located there.<ref name="Shipyards of Doom" />

==Behind the scenes==
The battle of Nexus Ortai was featured in the [[2008]] [[Star Wars comic books|graphic-novella]] ''[[The Clone Wars: Shipyards of Doom]]'', written by [[Henry Gilroy]] and illustrated by the [[Fillbach Brothers]], which serves as a tie-in to [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars|''The Clone Wars'' TV series]].<ref name="Shipyards of Doom" /> [[The Official Star Wars Fact File Part 29|''The Official Star Wars Fact File'' Part 29]] places the battle and the rest of the events of ''Shipyards of Doom'' between the episodes "[[Downfall of a Droid]]" and "[[Rookies (episode)|Rookies]]",<ref name="FF29">{{FactFile2014|29|GRI 5-8|General Grievous}}</ref> conflicting with both the series' chronological episode order&mdash;which places the "Rookies" arc before the "Downfall of a Droid" arc&mdash;<ref name="Order">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-clone-wars-chronological-episodeorder|text=''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' Chronological Episode Order}}</ref> and [[The Official Star Wars Fact File Part 23|''The Official Star Wars Fact File'' Part 23]], which places ''Shipyards of Doom'' before the [[Malevolence Campaign|''Malevolence'' Campaign]] that preceded both arcs.<ref name="FF-23" />
